findings.text: Decision 4 assumes a module-source hash detects failed recompilation, but changed imports or compiler options can cause failure while that hash and the previous compiled file remain unchanged. Fix: require a successful build before reporting and describe the hash as detecting source edits only.

Outcome 7 promises identical compiler messages, but outcome 12 and the accepted findings explicitly allow instrumentation to cause heartbeat-limit failures. Fix: qualify message preservation to exclude resource exhaustion caused by instrumentation.

The task substitutes `just test-scheduled-checks` for the governing `AGENTS.md` requirement of `just test-scheduled`, thereby omitting the mutant suites. Fix: require `just test-scheduled` at task completion.

The instruction assumes the native trace retains a structured `Name`, but Lean 4.34.1 converts it through `MessageData.ofName` into formatted text. Fix: specify that canonical names come from declaration information and are correlated with trace labels.
